title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (DNS, NTP, LDAP, Linux)
description:
Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989.
  
  
Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking a
**highly experienced Cloud Infrastructure Engineer**
to implement and support our current and future DNS architecture in private/public cloud. You will be directly responsible for ensuring the scalability, resilience, automation, and performance optimization of our DNS environment by leveraging Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools like Ansible, and Terraform, or Pulumi.
  
  
This is a deeply technical role requiring
**expert-level understanding of DNS, NTP, LDAP and extensive working knowledge on Linux Operating systems.**
You will also collaborate with platform and SRE teams to maintain secure, performant, and multi-tenant-isolated services that serve high-throughput, mission-critical applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Implement and support large scale DNS Architecture that stretches private & public cloud across multiple regions.
* Implement and support Infoblox DDI solutions (DNS, IPAM, DHCP), Cloudflare DNS management, Google & AWS DNS services.
* Implement and support highly reliable NTP and LDAP services on Linux instances.
* Implement Infrastructure as code leveraging CI/CD automation, Ansible, Terraform/Pulumi, Python and Bash for automated provisioning of DNS services.
* Build and manage CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure updates, patches, and rollbacks.
* Automate monitoring, alerting, and self-healing with GitOps and observability tools (Prometheus, Loki, Grafana).
* Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and scalable operations.
* Troubleshoot and analyze performance across hypervisors, storage, and networking.
* Support on-call rotation, incident response, and root cause analysis.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ in managing global DNS, NTP and LDAP systems on Linux Operating Systems.
* Proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code with Ansible, Terraform, or Pulumi.
* Working experience implementing OpenLDAP & NTP services (preferably Microchip SyncServer systems).
* Expertise with Infoblox DDI systems (or similar enterprise DNS systems: BlueCat, Bind9, CloudFlare, GCP and AWS DNS services).
* Familiar with various Infrastructure technology stacks like Hypervisor Technologies (KVM, Vsphere,), storage protocols (SDS) (iSCSI, NFS, CEPH), L2/L3 Networking
* Strong Linux (RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu) systems engineering background with advanced scripting in Python, Bash, or Go.
* Fluency with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated test frameworks.
* Strong experience supporting mission critical 24x7 customer facing production environments.
* Demonstrated success building or maintaining multi-region or high-availability OpenStack clusters.
* Ability to write technical documentation and contribute to community wikis or knowledge bases and background in large enterprise infrastructure environments.

**Nice to have:**

* Familiar with Cisco UCS Blade Servers (or similar server Infrastructure), Block/File Storage (Soft defined storage preferred).
* Understanding of security best practices for system patching and security compliance (e.g., CIS, NIST).
* Background in telco, edge cloud environments.

title: Jr. IT Administrator
description:
We are looking for a motivated Jr. IT Administrator with 1 - 2 years of experience to support our users, systems, and IT infrastructure. The candidate should be passionate about troubleshooting, problem-solving, and learning BIM technologies.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide day-to-day IT support and troubleshoot hardware, software, and Windows issues.
* Support BIM applications such as Revit, AutoCAD, and Navisworks.
* Troubleshoot Software, Licensing, Network, and Connectivity issues.
* Assist with Active Directory, Group Policy, Microsoft 365, DNS, and DHCP tasks.
* Manage IT assets, software licenses, and user access.
* Support employee onboarding and offboarding.
* Maintain IT documentation and coordinate with vendors when required.

**Required Skills:**

* 1 - 2 years of experience in IT Support / System Administration.
* Good Windows troubleshooting skills.
* Basic knowledge of Active Directory and Networking.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving mindset.
* Passion for learning BIM software and technologies.
* Good communication skills and willingness to learn.

title: IoT Architect
description:

 **IoT Architect** 
 to join our
 **Solution Engineering – IoT \& Digital Solutions Team** 
 and drive next\-generation IoT, Smart City, and Digital Transformation initiatives.
 



 📍
 **Location:** 
 Ernakulam / Thrissur
 



 💼
 **Experience:** 
 8–14 Years
 



 🏢
 **Department:** 
 Solution Engineering – IoT \& Digital Solutions Practice
   




 ◆ Role Overview
 
 The IoT Architect is a broad\-spectrum technology strategist responsible for designing end\-to\-end IoT solutions across devices, connectivity, edge computing, cloud platforms, and application layers. As Kerala Vision expands its Managed Services \& System Integration (MSI) business, IoT is a key growth area covering Smart Cities, Industrial IoT, Smart Metering, Fleet Management, Healthcare IoT, and Building Management Systems.
 


 ◆ Key Responsibilities
 * Design end\-to\-end IoT architectures covering device, connectivity, edge, cloud, and application layers.
* Architect solutions using AWS IoT, Azure IoT, Google Cloud IoT, ThingsBoard, and similar platforms.

 🎓 MCA / M.Sc. (IT/Networks) with relevant industry experience may also be considered.
 



 🎓 M.Tech / MBA (Technology Management) will be an added advantage.

 ✔ Proven experience in designing and delivering end\-to\-end IoT solutions.
 



 ✔ Strong understanding of IoT connectivity, cloud platforms, edge computing, analytics, and security.
 



 ✔ Excellent customer\-facing, pre\-sales, and solution presentation skills.
 



 ✔ Ability to translate complex technical architectures into business\-focused solutions.
